in_marathi.name: Ibitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ibitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ibitha is a name derived from Sanskrit, which translates to the Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity in Hindu mythology. She is a goddess revered for her ability to bestow riches, abundance, and prosperity upon her devotees.
